title: pleurospermum bicolor
intro: Pleurospermum bicolor, commonly known as Mountain Carrot or Bitter Carrot, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family. It is native to the mountainous regions of New Zealand and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Pleurospermum bicolor include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
